steps.low: Breathe in slowly, through your nose or your mouth, and let the air go low: your belly and your lower ribs widen, all the way round, while your shoulders stay still.
steps.hands: Put one hand on your belly, just above the navel, and the other on your lower ribs, at the side. Breathe in: both hands move out. Breathe out: they come back in.
steps.hiss: Now breathe out on a gentle, steady “sss”, like a slow leak, for a count of 4. Breathe in low again and hiss for a count of 8, then of 12.
steps.even: Keep the hiss even from start to end, without squeezing at the end, and stop before you run out of air. Singing uses the breath you have; it doesn’t force it out.
steps.warmUp: A minute of this is how every singing session starts. Next, your range: the app finds your lowest and highest comfortable notes, so every exercise fits your voice.
